note: Set B binds its member sections to specific elevations/details (HSS4X4X1/4 in C3, HSS4X6X1/4 and L4X4X5/16 in C1, W8X10 in the North/Bedroom elevation) and correctly captures the bay 10'-0" (grid C-D), 7'-6" (grids 4-5), 32'-0", 27'-8", Solar Envelope 18'-0" and T.O. Steel 11'-4". Set A gets the datum elevations right (FIRST FLR 2'-4", T.O. STEEL 11'-4" above grade, SOLAR ENVELOPE 18'-0") and adds the 3'-1" B-C bay, but it also misbinds dimensions: it calls 9'-0" the grade-to-T.O.-steel height (contradicting the 11'-4" datum), restates 27'-8" as "27 ft" from grid 8 to 4, and labels 3" and 8'-8 5/8" as structural-member heights. Set B's weaknesses are two confused conditions (grid spacing "between C4 and Grid 6", span "between grid D and C1"), one vague 2'-0" height-segment claim, and three duplicated claims (12'-0", 18'-0", 27'-8"), but it has fewer outright misreadings than A.
